beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Grading edits now show local save progress and failures separately from posting to Schoology. Task text stays editable while hidden, with a Show task on sample checkbox and a dedicated thread drawer.
• The course heading has a subtle clickable cue. Show task and Show link use matching compact controls, and Post teacher feedback to thread fades into emphasis on hover.
• Settings have searchable navigation, clearer Simple and Advanced mode guidance, and simpler connection, PDF, appearance, and celebration controls.
• Welcome setup shows connection progress and a scrollable checklist. Manual courses suggest school-year or semester dates from the selected calendar.
• Learning-period selection and to-do controls are easier to navigate. Sync review separates actual changes, protected students, and diagnostic details.
• Google Drive sources can last for the current school year or remain permanent. Beta testing offers explicit enrollment and a return-to-stable option.

Fixes:
• PDF page rendering runs in the background and reuses cached pages, with guards against showing an older submission after switching.
• Acknowledging an unchanged sync no longer runs an import. Background syncs and manually requested syncs use the appropriate status or review flow.
• Student updates and course tile animations do less unnecessary work, helping the app stay responsive.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
